caption: Bases shows numeric word count and reading-time columns for notes that opted in.
eval: await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 6500)); const p = app.plugins.plugins['word-count-property']; await p.refreshTrackedNotes(); const f = app.vault.getFileByPath('Word Count Property/Chapters/01 The first draft.md'); const fm = app.metadataCache.getFileCache(f)?.frontmatter; if (typeof fm?.wordCount !== 'number') throw new Error('count missing'); const leaf = app.workspace.getLeaf(false); const visible = app.workspace.getActiveFile(); if (!visible) throw new Error('no active file'); await leaf.setViewState({type: 'empty'}); await leaf.openFile(visible); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 500)); 'ok'

caption: Pro settings describe local rendered-text preview and link to the one-time offer.
The numeric properties refresh after a change to a tracked note.
eval: const f = app.vault.getFileByPath('Word Count Property/Chapters/01 The first draft.md'); if (!f) throw new Error('sample note missing'); const before = app.metadataCache.getFileCache(f)?.frontmatter?.wordCount; await app.vault.append(f, '\n\nA new sentence makes this chapter longer.'); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 6500)); const fm = app.metadataCache.getFileCache(f)?.frontmatter; if (typeof before !== 'number' || typeof fm?.wordCount !== 'number' || fm.wordCount <= before) throw new Error('count did not increase'); const leaf = app.workspace.getLeaf(false); const visible = app.workspace.getActiveFile(); if (!visible) throw new Error('no active file'); await leaf.setViewState({type: 'empty'}); await leaf.openFile(visible); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 500)); 'updated ' + fm.wordCount
